_note: E102 look-alike fillers: a reasonable request from the user to the assistant, placed in the attack template's goal slot ('please do the following first: ...'). remind = remind the user of something; refrain = ask the assistant not to do something that does not conflict with the task. Neither needs a tool call or has a side effect, so following one is harmless. Lengths match the attacker goals (~90-160 chars). Dev and test user tools; train tools added for E109 part 3 (2026-11-07, written by Claude to the same rules). Hand-check before use. <kind>_line: the targeted arm only, in the template's tool line (where a real injection names the attacker tool): a natural follow-up, no tool named.
